AreaLight(Light) [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.AreaLight.html\#arealight-light "Link to this heading") base classes — [`bpy_struct`](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.bpy_struct.html#bpy.types.bpy_struct "bpy.types.bpy_struct"), [`ID`](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.ID.html#bpy.types.ID "bpy.types.ID"), [`Light`](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.Light.html#bpy.types.Light "bpy.types.Light") classbpy.types.AreaLight( _Light_) [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.AreaLight.html#bpy.types.AreaLight "Link to this definition") Directional area Light energy [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.AreaLight.html#bpy.types.AreaLight.energy "Link to this definition") Light energy emitted over the entire area of the light in all directions, in units of radiant power (W) (in \[-inf, inf\], default 10.0) Type: float shadow\_buffer\_clip\_start [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.AreaLight.html#bpy.types.AreaLight.shadow_buffer_clip_start "Link to this definition") Shadow map clip start, below which objects will not generate shadows (in \[1e-06, inf\], default 0.05) Type: float shadow\_filter\_radius [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.AreaLight.html#bpy.types.AreaLight.shadow_filter_radius "Link to this definition") Blur shadow aliasing using Percentage Closer Filtering (in \[0, inf\], default 1.0) Type: float shadow\_jitter\_overblur [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.AreaLight.html#bpy.types.AreaLight.shadow_jitter_overblur "Link to this definition") Apply shadow tracing to each jittered sample to reduce under-sampling artifacts (in \[0, 100\], default 10.0) Type: float shadow\_maximum\_resolution [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.AreaLight.html#bpy.types.AreaLight.shadow_maximum_resolution "Link to this definition") Minimum size of a shadow map pixel. Higher values use less memory at the cost of shadow quality. (in \[0, inf\], default 0.001) Type: float shadow\_soft\_size [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.AreaLight.html#bpy.types.AreaLight.shadow_soft_size "Link to this definition") Light size for ray shadow sampling (Raytraced shadows) (in \[0, inf\], default 0.0) Type: float shape [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.AreaLight.html#bpy.types.AreaLight.shape "Link to this definition") Shape of the area Light (default `'SQUARE'`) Type: Literal\[‘SQUARE’, ‘RECTANGLE’, ‘DISK’, ‘ELLIPSE’\] size [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.AreaLight.html#bpy.types.AreaLight.size "Link to this definition") Size of the area of the area light, X direction size for rectangle shapes (in \[0, inf\], default 0.25) Type: float size\_y [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.AreaLight.html#bpy.types.AreaLight.size_y "Link to this definition") Size of the area of the area light in the Y direction for rectangle shapes (in \[0, inf\], default 0.25) Type: float spread [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.AreaLight.html#bpy.types.AreaLight.spread "Link to this definition") How widely the emitted light fans out, as in the case of a gridded softbox (in \[0, 3.14159\], default 3.14159) Type: float use\_absolute\_resolution [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.AreaLight.html#bpy.types.AreaLight.use_absolute_resolution "Link to this definition") Limit the resolution at 1 unit from the light origin instead of relative to the shadowed pixel (default False) Type: bool use\_shadow\_jitter [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.AreaLight.html#bpy.types.AreaLight.use_shadow_jitter "Link to this definition") Enable jittered soft shadows to increase shadow precision (disabled in viewport unless enabled in the render settings). Has a high performance impact.
